The following events took place in '''67 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] completes his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training.<ref name="VOJ">{{StoryCite|series=Star Wars (1998)|srtext=''Star Wars'' (1998)|issue1=4|issue2=6|story=Vow of Justice}}</ref>
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] votes to create more [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DP" />
*The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] is granted full [[Senator/Legends|representation]] in the Senate.<ref name="DP" />
*[[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] is betrayed and killed on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] by his apprentice [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
*[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] hosts a [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].<ref name="DP" />
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] sold as property to the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pi-Lippa]].<ref name="Annual 2008">''[[Star Wars Annual 2008]]''</ref>
